visualCharacteristics: New variant (no existing variants in project): Text-only tinted cards with H4, paragraph and outlined CTA pinned to bottom, 3 per row | White page background (visual tree rc3, colored:false). Contains 3 pale-blue text cards with outlined CTA buttons, then 3 alternating image/text teasers with circular images, then 'Related insights' H2 and 3 article cards (image, date, read time, H4 title, author, tag pill).

contentPattern.reason: Repeating look-alike items that each link to a detail page and wrap on smaller viewports; text-only cards with an empty image cell.

cells: Image (image, imageAlt); keep the cell even when empty

usage: Grid of text-only help/resource cards (3 per row on desktop). One row per card: image cell (usually empty) | heading, description and a trailing link paragraph that is pinned to the card bottom as the CTA.
reuseGuidance: Use for tinted info/help cards with a CTA. For article listings with image, date, author and tag use cards-insights.
